title: apium × moorei
intro: Apium × moorei, commonly known as celery root or celeriac, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the celery family (Apiaceae). It is a cool-season crop that offers several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Apium × moorei include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, digestive disorders, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Apium × moorei include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
